scope: Synthetic UI-test evidence only; no production or audit-policy change

observation.timing: Callback-time screen and optional single public element snapshot; not historical failing-size evidence or an atomic image/frame pair
observation.limit: At most two findings per Camera/Ask phase, before the unchanged exemption decision
observation.element: Optional; root attributes only. Missing element, failed snapshot, truncated metadata and missing attachments remain explicit
observation.existingExemption: Exact disabled-retrace contrast findings are not captured and consume no observation budget; original callback return decision remains unchanged
observation.timingLimit: Screenshots and snapshots of unhandled findings can still affect subsequent observation timing. Matching pre-audit geometry does not remove this observer effect.

export.normalMain: Uses the existing ui.xcresult; no additional audit invocation
export.selection: Exact authored before/after and callback screen/metadata names only; raw bundle and other attachments stay local
export.nativeOutcome: Separate from evidence completeness; missing after-capture is not an audit pass

preservedHistory.result: Build-for-testing timed out at 600 seconds; zero audit executions, zero screenshots; owned simulator deletion passed
preservedHistory.change: Add bounded sanitized normal-build progress and elapsed/termination metadata, without raising the 600-second cap or retrying selectors
preservedHistory.fullAppAudits: Earlier Camera header/button Dynamic Type findings and unidentified hit-region failure remain unresolved

validationLimit: Source and synthetic exporter/orchestration checks do not establish Apple compilation, callback reentrancy, screenshot timing or accessibility acceptance
